images.caption: Ardnamurchan: westernmost traffic light Not at a junction, but rather to control traffic in the walled section of single-carriageway road so that oncoming vehicles are not met where there is nowhere to pass. Anyway, it is certainly the most westerly traffic light on the mainland!

images.caption: Ardnamurchan High School The high school in Strontian serves the whole area, pulling in pupils from Ardnamurchan, Sunart, Morven, Ardgour further afield.  In spite of the wide catchment area, there are only around 100 pupils.  The building also houses the library and the Sunart Centre (Arainn Shuaineirt).
